thread:
alice: Quick sync: customers asking for a 'Flexible Commitment' product that lets them convert unused committed tokens into credits or roll them forward. Need product boundaries, billing rules, and contract language by EOD.
ben: High level: don't undermine commits. We can allow limited conversion but with clear penalties/fees to protect revenue predictability.
carmen: Two asks from customers: (1) monthly roll-forward of up to 25% unused commit, (2) conversion of unused commit to burst credits at a discount.
devin: Infra note: roll-forward is just a bookkeeping flag. Conversion to credits needs a SKU and expiry semantics. Both doable.
emma: Pricing POV: propose conversion fee = 15% of committed value for credits conversion. Roll-forward free for up to 25% (use-or-lose beyond that).
alice: Also need to define who can buy this: all paid tiers or enterprise-only? Sales asked Starter+ at least.
ben: Recommend Starter+ for roll-forward, enterprise only for auto-convert with legal clause. Keep Simple for Free/trial.
carmen: Contract constraint: if customer reduces commit next period, how do we apply rolled/converted amounts? Must be against the current billing envelope, not previous.
devin: Implementation sketch:
```
commit = tenant.commited_tokens_month
used = tenant.actual_tokens
unused = max(0, commit - used)
roll_forward_allowed = min(unused, 0.25 * commit)
convert_to_credits = unused - roll_forward_allowed
```
Then convert_to_credits * price * (1 - discount) -> credit units.
```

emma: Edge cases: mid-month cancellations, partial refunds, and audit trail. Finance wants conversion events logged as adjustments with reason codes.
acct-bot: Reminder: any conversion that affects revenue recognition must include SKU and contract amendment id.
alice: UX: in Console show a "Commit Summary" with a one-click convert or schedule roll-forward at month boundary. Show projected invoice delta.
ben: Billing behavior: implement as separate invoice lines: "Commit Roll-forward (25%)" and "Converted Credits (15% fee applied)". All conversions carry tag=FLEX-CVT.
carmen: For pilot, propose limits: max 25% roll-forward, conversion allowed once per billing period, credits expire in 90 days unless on annual commit.
devin: Telemetry: we need telemetry to verify no abuse. Add guardrail: if a tenant converts >50% of commit 2 months in a row, flag for sales review.
emma: Pricing tweak: conversion discount for pilots: 20% off fee (i.e., fee becomes 12%) to encourage adoption. Post-pilot fee 15%.
alice: Decision (tentative): Ship pilot with Starter+ roll-forward and Enterprise conversion. Limits: 25% roll-forward, single conversion per billing period, credits expire 90d, pilot conversion fee = 12%.
ben: Launch gating: - billing export shows conversion lines - console UI shows opt-in toggle and sample invoice - legal sign-off on amendment language - 2 pilot customers signed
carmen: Contract snippet to include: "Unused committed tokens up to 25% may be rolled to the following billing period. Remaining unused tokens may be converted to burst credits subject to a conversion fee. Credits expire per schedule in the ratecard."
acct-bot: Action created: SKU FLEX-CVT-01, ratecard entry pending.
alice: Owners: @devin infra for meter & invoice support (ETA 2w), @emma pricing + pilot offers (ETA 3d), @carmen legal snippet + sales one-pager (ETA 3d), @ben revenue ops test invoices (ETA 5d).
devin: One more: need to confirm how conversions interact with partner resellers. Flagging for later: partner flows.
alice: Cool — I'll post summary to product docs and add to roadmap board. Thanks team :rocket:
ben: I'll draft sample invoice rows and send to finance for review.
emma: I'll prepare a short FAQ for sales explaining "why fee exists" and the pilot discount.
carmen: Looping in legal after I draft the snippet.
